title: Normandy: D-Day to Cobra (6 Jun - 31 Jul 1944)

briefing.historical: On 6 June 1944 the Allies landed on five Normandy beaches, Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno and Sword, after airborne drops on both flanks. Carentan, Saint-Lo, Bayeux and Caen remained in German hands after the first day; Cherbourg fell on 26 June, Caen on 21 July, and Operation Cobra reached Avranches on 31 July (M01, M02, M11).
briefing.situation: The Allies must hold the beaches, link the beachheads, take Cherbourg and Caen and break out; the Germans must contain the lodgement with static divisions and arriving panzer reserves under Allied air supremacy. Start positions and several arrival points and times are approximate; Canadian, Polish and French follow-on divisions beyond those listed, naval and air forces are not included (not retrieved).

playableNations.summary: Land at Utah and Omaha, take Cherbourg, break out at Cobra.
Land at Gold and Sword, take Caen against the panzer divisions.
Land at Juno and fight for Carpiquet and Caen.
Contain the beachheads with static divisions and arriving panzers under Allied air supremacy.

GAME-SCALE ABSTRACTION (internal): manpower, equipment, morale/experience, resources, objective points, thresholds, port ramp times, landing casualties and dispersion, air-supremacy radius and speed are nominal game values, not historical strengths. Sourced strengths used where stated: 352nd ID about 12,000 and 716th about 6,000 (M04, M05), 3rd Canadian Division about 22,500 (M06), Cherbourg garrison 21,000 (M10), Panzer Lehr 208 tanks and assault guns (M12).
LOCATION POLICY (internal): locations are real towns/beaches placed at Wikipedia (M14) or Nominatim (M15) coordinates, nudged to the nearest land cell of the terrain grid where needed (G02).

POSITION POLICY (internal): no source gives division-level start positions; unit positions are approximate sector anchors inferred from the named areas in M01-M12, with a small deterministic spread. Every unit position is APPROXIMATE.
BORDER POLICY (internal): initialControl is one coarse German-held polygon over the whole map; the Allies hold nothing until the landings (no sourced front line for 6 June 00:00).
